name: Bondage Game ~Shinsou no Reijou-tachi~
original_name: ボンデージ・ゲーム　～深窓の隷嬢達～
source:
Yuu is a girl who has lost her memories. She is mailed into a sadistic house of bondage where she and others are forced (or not) to serve their master, but there are serious consequences for those who fail.

[From [url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=4556]ANN[/url]]
translation:
Yuu是一个失去记忆的女孩。她被送到一个虐待狂的奴役之家，在那里她和其他人被迫（或不）为他们的主人服务，但失败的人会面临严重的后果。

[来自[url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=4556]ANN[/url]]
